name: leticode
description: The leticode bridge for Claude Code: the MCP tools that hold leticode sessions and the rooms, the channel that pushes their turn ends, asks and failures into the session, the room waiter, and the skills that drive them, and panes beside the chat for packages, remote runs, a package's transcript and this seat's todo board.

monitors.name: room-waiter
monitors.command: while :; do letibot-mcp room-wait --attention to_me --timeout 1h || sleep 10; sleep 2; done
monitors.description: leticode room messages for this seat

monitors.name: todo-nag
monitors.command: while :; do letibot-mcp todo-wait --timeout 1h || sleep 10; sleep 2; done
monitors.description: this seat's todo plan check, when the bridge says it is due
